bullets.text: Managed Wi-Fi Needs Support — The bulk-managed Wi-Fi industry faces regulatory challenges threatening its economic model.
New Subsea Cable for Greece — **Grid Telecom** announces the ARTEMIS subsea cable, enhancing regional connectivity.
Russian Satellites Raise Concerns — **Luch satellites** pose new risks to European satellite communications.
Nokia's Co-Dependence Insight — **Nokia** highlights the intertwined telecom supply chains between Europe and the US.
Vodafone Idea Expands 4G — **Vodafone Idea** boosts its 4G network with over 6,500 new towers.
Openreach's Safety Initiative — **Openreach** launches an app to protect engineers from abuse in the field.
AT&T Acquires Fiber Business — **AT&T** completes a $5.75 billion acquisition of **Lumen's** fiber operations.
5G-A Innovations in Malaysia — **U Mobile** targets 5G-A use cases with a new enterprise innovation platform.
AI's Impact on Subsea Cables — **Google** and **Meta** discuss how AI is reshaping subsea cable infrastructure.
Libya Joins 5G Wave — **Almadar Aljadid** launches 5G in Tripoli, marking a milestone for North Africa.
